subject: Workday vendor activation: cross-tenant redirect & cookie mismatch
messages:
From: Angela Park <angela.park@stellacorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Can't complete vendor activation — Workday invite loop

Hi Vivek,

We're onboarding BrightForge as a supplier and their finance contact (Luis Hernandez) keeps getting redirected to a generic checkout/marketing page when he clicks the Workday supplier invite. The original invite shows as accepted in our portal but the vendor still can't claim the tenant.

What we tried:
- Resent the invite from the console (same behavior)
- Tried different browsers and Safari on macOS (same redirect)
- Cleared cookies/cache on the vendor machine (no change)

Attached is a screenshot of the redirect flow (screenshot-redirect.png) and the invite link (workday-invite-link.txt). The vendor sees the URL briefly include "tenant_hint=" then a 302 to an external marketing page that isn't related to their company.

This is blocking the first PO for $45k and accounting needs the supplier active by EOD Tuesday. Can you advise next steps or a temporary workaround?

Thanks,
Angela Park
Senior Procurement Manager
StellaCorp
ag.park@stellacorp.com

Hi Angela — thanks for the detailed repro and the attachments. Sorry you're hitting this. I'm looping in Ben from infra/ops and Marissa on the account so we can triage quickly.

Immediate plan (mutual action):
1) Ben will confirm whether we're seeing a state/tenant_hint mismatch server-side and create a short-lived manual invite if needed (target: <24h).
2) Angela, if possible, please have the vendor try an incognito window and capture a HAR (network_trace.har) — Ben will provide exact steps below.
3) We'll open INF-4721 and keep you posted in Jira; I'll add the PO and SLA impact to the ticket.

Ben — two specifics from Angela's trace: 302 that contains tenant_hint then redirects to an external domain. My hunch is a stale cookie or a routing rule that falls back to a marketing route when tenant lookup fails. Can you confirm? If we need to perform a quick server-side invalidate for the BrightForge tenant, let me know and we'll coordinate a manual invite via a hashed one-time URL.

Marissa — can you flag internal CS/finance so they hold the PO until we confirm supplier activation?

I'll put INF-4721 in the subject and reply-all as things progress.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Angela Park <angela.park@stellacorp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't complete vendor activation — Workday invite loop

Thanks for the context — dug into logs overnight. Notes:
- INF-4721 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4721
- We see BrightForge tenant lookup returning 200, but the session cookie (rdw_sid) has a domain attribute set to ".redwood-marketing.com" for this request path. That explains the redirect: when tenant resolution returns empty for the app cookie path, our edge routing applies a default marketing fallback.

Quick diagnostic steps for Angela/Luis:
1) Please try the invite in a Chrome Incognito window (this bypasses cookies).
2) If the redirect still happens, capture a HAR (Chrome DevTools -> Network -> Right click -> Save all as HAR) and send it to us.

Workarounds we can do from our side:
- Issue a one-time hashed invite URL scoped to the tenant (expires 24h). I'll generate and paste it below once I confirm it's safe.
- If this is reproducible for other vendors on StellaCorp, we should patch CSRF/cookie domain rules in the next sprint (INF-4721).

Attached are the exact steps I used to reproduce locally and a small session dump excerpt (network_trace.har).

Temporary one-time invite (do not publish): https://redwood-invite.redwoodai.com/h/9f3b2c6a
(Expires: 2026-08-09T12:00:00Z)

Let me know if the one-time link gets your vendor in. If not, please forward the HAR and I will escalate to edge-team to do a live inspect during the vendor's attempt.

— Ben Carter
SRE, Inference Platform
ben@redwood.com
From: Angela Park <angela.park@stellacorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't complete vendor activation — Workday invite loop

Ben / Vivek — quick update: the one-time invite worked and Luis was able to claim the BrightForge tenant and complete the tax form. We had him use the incognito workaround first but the one-time link was the cleanest fix.

We attached the HAR (sent over via HubSpot file) — it does show the rdw_sid cookie set to .redwood-marketing.com and the 302 to marketing.example.com when tenant lookup returns null.

Two asks:
- Can you provide an ETA for a permanent fix so future vendors don't hit this?
- Please confirm that previous failed activations for this BrightForge invite will not cause duplicate supplier profiles or failed PO routing.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — Marissa please follow up on the PO hold with finance.

Best,
Angela Park
Senior Procurement Manager, StellaCorp
ag.park@stellacorp.com
